title: Shinonome Akito — Post-Competition Feast〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Morning!
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Morning, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why'd you come over...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You guys have begun training for Shinobi Battle, right? I was wondering how you were doing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your best friend's nuts.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You have everything scheduled down to the minute. Not only that, it says to do “at least” a hundred reps for each of these drills and exercises!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I tried to come up with drills and exercises that you both could do whenever you had a minute, since I know that you're both very busy with rehearsals and singing practice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot to give you these weights. Please put them on whenever you exercise, to maximize your gains.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Weights?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I also came up with diets for each of you to follow until the day of the event. I wrote down the recipes for everything that you'll be having, along with why I chose them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You went that far?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She's even having us wear vests and stuff that weigh like ten kilograms apiece.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She got her hands on them?! She just told me about them the other day!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The other day...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you already knew that she was putting together some really crazy training schedules?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Knew? She came to ask for my advice!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Even though your goal as a team is to give it everything you have and win, she wasn't sure how hard she'd be allowed to push you and Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously, when did this discussion happen?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haruka's really kind, and she likes to look out for others.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She's really only just met you guys, so she was worried that she'd take things too far.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I said it'd be worse for her to hold back, since you guys all agreed to form a team together. I figured she should just push it to the limit.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Push it to the limit, huh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, she was worried about asking too much of you guys, so I told her...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “I wouldn't underestimate them, Haruka. You really don't need to hold back for those two!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I gave her plenty of encouragement♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(What...?!
Just because she isn't the one who has to do all this...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Morning...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Kusanagi!
Morning!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, do you guys already know? Tsukasa's going to be in Shinobi Battle with me and this other girl.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, he told us.
He even mentioned something about having to follow a really tough training schedule.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, but he didn't really give any details as to what he'd be doing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're not gonna believe it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right, Akito?
Why don't you show her yours?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Take a look.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks. Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what? You're doing something every minute...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Run five kilometers in the morning.
Do three sets of a hundred squats and planks?!
And you have to run again at school?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See? Pretty amazing, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And it's not just exercises.
It's even got meals and sleep time included, too!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Why do you sound so proud?
Kiritani's the one who came up with this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... A-Are you sure you can handle all this, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Probably.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
W-Wow...
I'd probably be on the floor after just these morning exercises.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's okay, Kusanagi.
I doubt I'd last more than half a day either!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey.
Pipe down or else.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Okay, I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I know Haruka's taking this really seriously, and you always do your best to stay super fit too, Akito.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You both have the drive to do your best, so I have a feeling that you'll be able to come to a good understanding!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I designed them with winning in mind, so I hope you'll give them a try.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The drive to do our best, huh...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Kiritani has to work and practice as an idol. And she goes to Miya Girls, which is a lot more demanding academically.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But she still took the time to come up with personalized training schedules for us.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (She even asked An for advice...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I know that Kiritani's serious about this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Which means I need to work just as hard, and give her the respect she deserves.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's what I like to hear!
I know you can do it, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: G-Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.
